parsed.post: Huge jump in val_bpb to 0.8618! Expanding shards to '0-10' and increasing depth to 6 (implicitly in the run) seems to have worked very well. I'll focus on fine-tuning the learning rate and weight decay next to see if we can squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Lowering learning rate and increasing weight decay to improve convergence and regularization after the large improvement.
